data.summary:
This unit must join a **COMMAND SQUAD**:

- as the Declare Battle Formations step begins, it joins one **COMMAND SQUAD** unit of yours; a **COMMAND SQUAD** can have only one Regimental Attaché unit joined
- from then until the battle ends, its models count as part of that **COMMAND SQUAD**, whose **Starting Strength** rises to match
- if it cannot join one this way, it is left out of the battle and is treated as **destroyed**
- while joined, it may embark in any **TRANSPORT** the **COMMAND SQUAD** can embark in
